MEDIA_SLUG_MAX_LENGTH

Cap on the media deep-link slug (/portfolio/<project>/<media>) so prerendered dist paths keep wide headroom under the Windows MAX_PATH (260) bound even inside deep clone prefixes — truncation lands on a hyphen boundary, never mid-word.
